$comment: Standing authority boundaries for autonomous changes (docs/autonomy/ARCHITECTURE.md section 3, approved by Jack 2026-10-11). These are L3 and change only with Jack's approval. Paths here are closed to autonomous edits whether or not any blocker is open. Blockers (autonomy/blockers.json) add to this list; they never subtract from it.
l3_note: autonomy/attestations.jsonl is L3 because only a person may attest; human-facts.json and deployment-readiness.json because editing them redefines what verified and ready mean. autonomy/suites.json is L3 because changing what is registered, or whether it blocks, changes what 'green' means. An agent that could edit it could make any failure non-blocking.
